content.comment_body: Hello, Are the AI bars showing empty content on the web interface? Is there a known fix for this in the latest SP1 update?
We suggest trying the latest version of [product_name] (V1 SP1) and checking if the issue persists. You can download SP1 from the following link: [url]

Could you clarify your question? The value for an AI has typically appeared in [product_name], even before support for service pack 1 was introduced. Can you provide more details or perhaps a screenshot of the issue?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing missing content in AI (Analog Input) bars within the web interface of [product_name]. There is some confusion about whether this is a limitation, a bug, or if it has been resolved in the SP1 update. Support recommends updating to the latest version, while another user suggests the feature should have worked previously and asks for more detailed information. This points to unclear product behavior and communication, with a need for better issue documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect AI bars (analog input data visualizations) to display content correctly in the web interface, and are looking for confirmation on whether updating the software resolves the problem.
